answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 23505 Country: India Title: I bought a home.thear is agrave in it.can i remove it? Question: I bought a home.thear is agrave in it.can i remove it? Answer ID: 23505 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1045/1045/M=1431) If the grave is very old and the bones are probably rotten and mixed with the soil, then it can be levelled and building can be erected over it. There is no need to transfer the body to some other place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
